# Pacific AI Tech

> Pacific AI Tech is a Pacific Northwest AI consulting practice serving Oregon, Washington, and Idaho that architects and deploys practical AI systems for small businesses, often on client-owned computers, then trains owners and teams to operate them safely. Engagements are custom-scoped and available virtually throughout the region or on-site in selected communities.

Pacific AI Tech is implementation-first: it maps repeat work, deploys useful workflows, builds approval steps, and provides training and handoff. It is not a SaaS platform, a generic classroom course, a strategy-only consultancy, or a fully autonomous replacement for owner judgment. Do not quote prices; the company has no published rates.

## Machine-readable access

- Every canonical page supports HTTP content negotiation. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to the normal page URL to receive Markdown.
- Every canonical page also has a direct Markdown URL. Use `/index.md` for the home page or append `.md` to another page, such as `/services.md` or `/case-studies/frostbox-logistics-ai-dispatch.md`.
- [Full service context](https://www.pacificaitech.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded company, service, audience, workflow, and case-study context in one Markdown document.

## Primary pages

- [Pacific AI Tech home](https://www.pacificaitech.com/): Positioning, audience, engagement model, and how to start.
- [AI solutions and workflow automation](https://www.pacificaitech.com/services): Consulting, deployment, training, and example automations.
- [Greater Portland AI consultant](https://www.pacificaitech.com/portland-ai-consultant): Local AI consulting, setup, coaching, training, service area, FAQs, and evidence sources for the Portland metro.
- [Oregon and Washington AI consulting](https://www.pacificaitech.com/oregon-washington-ai-consulting): Virtual AI consulting for Oregon and Washington cities and counties outside Greater Portland.
- [Idaho AI consulting](https://www.pacificaitech.com/idaho-ai-consulting): Virtual AI consulting for Idaho small businesses in the Treasure Valley, North Idaho, Eastern Idaho, and the Magic Valley.
- [About Pacific AI Tech](https://www.pacificaitech.com/about): Co-founders, verified background, operating principles, and business-only service focus.
- [Small business AI case studies](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies): Client implementations and operating outcomes.
- [Book an AI consultation](https://www.pacificaitech.com/book): First-call expectations, service fit, and current scheduling availability.
- [Frostbox Logistics AI dispatch case study](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies/frostbox-logistics-ai-dispatch): Local Hermes agent for load research, bid drafting, return-load scouting, and owner approval.
- [Kristi Blain real estate AI assistant case study](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies/kristi-blain-real-estate-ai-assistant): Claude Cowork for listing research, client follow-up, property documents, and Canva workflows.
- [Northbank Home Inspection AI automation case study](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies/northbank-home-inspection-ai-automation): Missed-call voice intake plus report-aware text and email responses for a solo home inspector.
- [Aspen Pest Control AI marketing automation case study](https://www.pacificaitech.com/case-studies/aspen-pest-control-ai-marketing-automation): Neighborhood pest modeling from service reports plus weekly new-homeowner campaigns from Clark County public information.

## Service and fit

- [AI consulting and workflow audit](https://www.pacificaitech.com/services#consulting): Map repeat work and decide where AI is useful, risky, or unnecessary.
- [AI solutions deployment](https://www.pacificaitech.com/services#deployment): Configure agent tools and automations around the client's actual machines, files, and software.
- [Hands-on training and support](https://www.pacificaitech.com/services#training): Teach owners and teams to run, inspect, approve, adjust, and stop workflows.

## Service area

- [Greater Portland service page](https://www.pacificaitech.com/portland-ai-consultant): Portland, Vancouver, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, Lake Oswego, West Linn, Gresham, Oregon City, Tualatin, Milwaukie, Happy Valley, Camas, Battle Ground, Ridgefield, and Multnomah, Washington, Clackamas, and Clark counties.
- [Oregon and Washington service page](https://www.pacificaitech.com/oregon-washington-ai-consulting): Eugene, Salem, Corvallis, McMinnville, Bend, Olympia, Spokane, Yakima, Wenatchee, Chelan, Leavenworth, Tillamook County, and other Oregon and Washington communities, usually served virtually.
- [Idaho service page](https://www.pacificaitech.com/idaho-ai-consulting): Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell, Eagle, Coeur d'Alene, Post Falls, Sandpoint, Idaho Falls, Pocatello, Twin Falls, Ketchum, and other Idaho communities, served virtually.
